sections.section_title: GPIO port mode register (GPIOx_MODER) (x = A to H)
sections.text_helper: Section 11.4.1 "GPIO port mode register (GPIOx_MODER) (x = A to H)" in chapter 11 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 348.
sections.section_content:
Address offset:0x00
Reset value: 0xABFF FFFF (for port A)
Reset value: 0xFF3F FEBF (for port B)
Reset value: 0xFFFF FFFF (for the other ports)
Bits 31:0 MODEy[1:0]: Port x configuration I/O pin y (y = 15 to 0)
These bits are written by software to configure the I/O mode.
00: Input mode
01: General purpose output mode
10: Alternate function mode
11: Analog mode (reset state)
Note: The bitfield is reserved and must be kept to reset value when the corresponding I/O is
not available on the selected package.
